categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文都在给LLM Agent与世界模型补短板——验证、抗注入、多模态生成与机器人操作。

articles.title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
articles.zh: 4D-HOF：面向前馈式4D手-物交互重建的手-物流匹配方法
articles.summary: 如果你在做手物交互重建、嫌优化式方法太慢，这个前馈+流匹配的路子值得看一眼
articles.author: Shiqi Li, Sean Cho 等
articles.body: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.
articles.bodyZh: 现在已有的4D手-物重建（4D hand-object reconstruction）方法，经常得靠很贵的逐序列优化（per-sequence optimization），而生成式方法（generative approaches）通常又是从随机噪声（random noise）里硬造出交互，结果就容易导致交互预测不稳定。我们提出4D-HOF，一个前馈框架（feed-forward framework）：它拿视觉基础模型（vision foundation models）给出的粗略但信息量很大的估计，来重建4D手和物体的交互。具体说，我们学了一个条件流匹配模型（conditional flow matching model），把基础模型推出来的手-物状态，往一个交互流形（interaction manifold）上搬，这样模型就能以前馈方式修正平移、旋转和对齐上的错误。我们这种生成式思路有个关键好处：它天然就能在传输过程（transport process）里做测试时引导（test-time guidance）。我们不是等重建完再做单独的事后优化（post-hoc optimization），而是直接用物理交互约束（physical interaction constraints）和观察到的2D证据（2D evidence）去引导正在演化的生成状态，让重建本身就在生成过程中被不断修好。通过在多样化数据集上训练这个生成模型，4D-HOF能很稳地泛化到很有挑战的真实场景。在域外基准（out-of-domain benchmarks）上的实验显示，4D-HOF达到了当前最优（state-of-the-art）表现，重建出来的4D手-物交互更稳定也更准。

articles.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
articles.zh: IdeaAnchor：教LLM把文献变成研究想法
articles.summary: 如果你指望LLM帮你读文献找选题，这篇讲的正是怎么让它别只会总结、而是锚定出真正可做的研究点
articles.author: Ziyu Chen, Yilun Zhao 等
articles.body: Scientific research often begins by synthesizing ideas from a set of related papers to identify gaps and formulate new directions. However, training language models to perform this form of literature-grounded ideation remains challenging, as existing approaches based on prompting or feedback lack structured supervision for how papers should be synthesized. We introduce IdeaAnchor, a paradigm for training LLMs to perform research ideation using structured specifications as privileged signals. Each IdeaAnchor instance encodes how each input paper should be synthesized into a successful idea, including their functional roles, relationships, and target synthesis criteria. We build this paradigm by mining instances from published papers, capturing how real ideas emerge from prior literature. We then train models via demonstration, self-distillation, and reinforcement learning, and further enhance generation with retrieval at inference time. Experiments show consistent improvements in ideation quality. Our analysis reveals a functional decomposition: anchor-based training strengthens creative synthesis, retrieval enhances detail elaboration, and combining both yields the best performance.
articles.bodyZh: 科学研究常常是从综合一堆相关论文里的想法开始的：先找出研究空白，再提出新方向。可麻烦的是，想训练语言模型（language models）来做这种基于文献的构思（literature-grounded ideation），一直不容易。因为现有那些靠提示（prompting）或反馈（feedback）的方法，缺一套结构化的监督（structured supervision），没法告诉模型论文到底该怎么综合。我们提出了 IdeaAnchor，这是一套训练大语言模型（LLMs）做科研构思（research ideation）的范式（paradigm），核心是把结构化规范（structured specifications）当成特权信号（privileged signals）。每个 IdeaAnchor 实例都会写清楚：输入的每篇论文该怎么被综合成一个成功想法，包括它们各自的功能角色（functional roles）、彼此之间的关系（relationships），以及目标综合标准（target synthesis criteria）。我们是从已发表论文里挖出这些实例来搭这套范式的，等于把真实想法怎么从已有文献里冒出来的过程抓下来。然后我们用示范（demonstration）、自蒸馏（self-distillation）和强化学习（reinforcement learning）来训练模型，还在推理阶段（inference time）加上检索（retrieval）来进一步增强生成。实验表明，构思质量（ideation quality）有稳定提升。我们的分析还拆出了一种功能分解（functional decomposition）：基于锚点的训练（anchor-based training）能加强创造性综合（creative synthesis），检索（retrieval）能提升细节展开（detail elaboration），两者合起来效果最好。

articles.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
articles.zh: DepthWorld：面向机器人操作任务的3D世界模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做机器人操作，这篇把深度信息塞进世界模型，重点在预测而非重建
articles.author: Jai Bardhan, Josef Sivic 等
articles.body: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.
articles.bodyZh: 世界模型（World models）给机器人领域（robotics）提供了一条数据驱动的路子，可以替代传统模拟器（simulators），能用在策略评估（policy evaluation）、策略改进（policy improvement）和规划（planning）上。但这些用途全都得依赖准确的三维几何（3D geometry），可现在的基于视频的世界模型只靠 RGB（红绿蓝）图像训练，生成出来的推演结果（rollouts）虽然逐帧看没问题，拼起来却不是一个前后一致的三维世界。要补上这个差距，得在两方面取得进展：一是给机器人操作（manipulation）提供大规模三维监督（3D supervision），二是要有一个架构，能把这些监督吸收进去，还不破坏已经很强的预训练视频先验（video priors）。我们提出了一套标定流程（calibration pipeline），把学到的立体深度（stereo depth）和一个联合因子图（joint factor graph）结合起来，把同一台实体机器人上收集到的所有回合片段（episodes）汇总到一起，从而还原它共用的运动学参数（kinematic parameters），同时也把每个场景的外参（extrinsics）恢复出来。把它用在 DROID 数据集上，就得到了 DROID-3D：这是一个标定好的三维数据集，能提供稠密的度量深度（metric depth）和重新标定过的多视角外参，对于外部相机来说，在 90% 的回合片段上，重投影误差（reprojection error）都低于 0.7 像素。然后我们训练了 DepthWorld，这是一个基于 Stable Video Diffusion 的世界模型，它通过空间潜变量分块（spatial latent tiling）来同时预测多视角 RGB 和深度，同时让预训练好的变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder, VAE）保持不变。在同等训练预算下，深度监督让 RGB 预测本身比一个完全一样的纯 RGB 基线（baseline）提高了 1.48 dB 的峰值信噪比（PSNR），同时还生成了准确的度量深度，供下游几何推理（geometric reasoning）使用。

articles.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
articles.summary: 如果你在让模型当"老师"讲题，这篇说的是教学策略得随学生水平动态调整，一套话术走天下是不行的
articles.author: Weixian Xu, Yanzhe Zhang 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable problem solvers, but being able to solve a problem is not the same as being able to teach it. Existing approaches to training LLMs as teachers rely on demonstrations, preference data, or predefined pedagogical criteria that specify what good teaching looks like. However, these signals are often not grounded in individual student learning outcomes, where effective teaching strategies can vary substantially across learners. To address this, we introduce Sherpa, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that instantiates multiple student archetypes with LLMs conditioned on distinct learning preferences and trains a teacher model to adapt its instruction by directly maximizing their learning outcomes. Teacher LLMs trained with Sherpa improve instructed students' performance across all archetypes by an average of 20.5 percentage points. Under MathTutorBench's evaluation, Sherpa raises the overall pedagogy score from 52.5% to 79.2%, indicating better teaching responses. Our human studies show that the trained teacher is preferred over the base model in 79.6% of pairwise comparisons. Together, Sherpa trains LLM teachers to adapt to diverse simulated students and become better aligned with human teachers, paving the road towards AI tutors teaching real students.
articles.bodyZh: 现在的大语言模型（LLMs）越来越会解题了，可会解题和会教人，完全是两码事。现有那些把大语言模型训练成老师的方法，靠的是示范、偏好数据，或者提前定好一套“好老师该是什么样”的标准。但这些信号往往没有落到每个学生自己的学习成果上，而真正有效的教法，对不同学习者可能差得很远。为了解决这一点，我们提出了 Sherpa：一个多轮强化学习（multi-turn reinforcement learning）框架，它用大语言模型造出多种学生原型（student archetypes），并让这些原型带着不同的学习偏好，然后训练一个教师模型，让它通过直接最大化学生的学习成果，来随时调整自己的教法。用 Sherpa 训练出来的教师大语言模型，能让所有原型里的被指导学生，表现平均提高 20.5 个百分点。在 MathTutorBench 的评测中，Sherpa 把整体教学法（pedagogy）得分从 52.5% 拉到 79.2%，说明它的教学回应更好了。我们的人类研究（human studies）也显示，在成对比较（pairwise comparisons）里，有 79.6% 的情况，人们更选训练后的老师，而不是基础模型。总的来说，Sherpa 能把大语言模型老师训练得会适应各种各样的模拟学生，也更像人类老师，为 AI 导师真正去教真实学生铺平了路。

articles.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
articles.zh: 瓶中Agent：LLM Agent能否把自身能力固化成廉价、可扩展的产物？
articles.summary: 如果你想知道Agent除了一次性干活还能留下什么，这篇探讨的是把能力固化成可复用、可规模化的组件
articles.author: Ankit Sonthalia, Haritz Puerto 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) can solve many narrow tasks, but querying them separately for millions of related instances can be prohibitively expensive. Can LLM agents autonomously create cheaper solutions for such workloads? We call this ability "bottling": the ability to turn general capabilities into task-specific solutions that balance answer quality and amortised cost. We introduce BOTTLED, a benchmark in which agents receive an entire unlabelled workload and must complete it under fixed time, compute and LLM API budgets. Agents choose their own approach, such as training a small model or writing a reusable program. Across ten models and three tasks, we find that strong zero-shot task performance does not reliably translate into strong bottling capabilities. Models with similar zero-shot scores can differ substantially after bottling, and 48 of 60 bottling runs score below the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of their model's zero-shot performance. Moreover, 31 of 60 runs underperform the stronger of two small-model distillation baselines with the same token budget. Nevertheless, bottling can yield substantial savings: on query-product relevance classification, Opus 5 retains about 82% of its zero-shot macro-F1 at roughly 657 times lower reported cost. Bottling is also competitive with Jev, a "system one" model built especially for cheap, repetitive inference: Opus 5 on the same task recovers about 94% of Jev's macro-F1 at a quarter of Jev's projected full-workload cost. BOTTLED provides a basis for evaluating and improving agents' ability to invest limited resources in reusable solutions for large, repetitive workloads.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能搞定很多很窄的任务，但要是为了几百万条相关数据，一条一条分别去问它们，成本可能高到离谱。那大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）能不能自己琢磨出更省钱的解法，来应付这种工作负载（workloads）呢？我们把这种本事叫“装瓶”（bottling）：也就是把通用能力变成针对具体任务的方案，同时兼顾答案质量和摊薄成本（amortised cost）。我们做了个基准测试（benchmark），叫 BOTTLED。在这个测试里，智能体会拿到一整套没有标注的活儿，然后必须在固定的时间、算力和 LLM API 预算里把它干完。智能体可以自己选路子，比如训个小模型，或者写个能反复用的程序。我们试了十个模型、三个任务，发现零样本（zero-shot）任务表现强，并不一定就能说明它“装瓶”能力强。零样本分数差不多的模型，装瓶之后可能差很多；60 次装瓶跑下来，有 48 次比它们自己模型零样本表现 95% 置信区间（confidence interval）的下限还低。而且，60 次里有 31 次，哪怕给同样的词元（token）预算，也比两个小模型蒸馏（distillation）基线里更强的那个还差。不过，装瓶确实能省一大笔：在查询-商品相关性分类（query-product relevance classification）任务上，Opus 5 能保住大约 82% 的零样本宏平均 F1（macro-F1），而报告成本大约低了 657 倍。装瓶也能跟 Jev 掰掰手腕。Jev 是个专门为便宜、重复推理（inference）打造的“系统一”（system one）模型：同一个任务里，Opus 5 能拿回 Jev 大约 94% 的宏平均 F1，而预计处理完整工作量的成本只有 Jev 的四分之一。BOTTLED 提供了一个基础，让我们能评估并改进智能体在大型、重复性工作负载里，把有限资源投到可复用方案上的能力。

articles.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
articles.zh: AdvSim2Real：在Web世界模型中训练抵御自适应提示注入的Web Agent
articles.summary: 如果你在做Web Agent，这篇提醒你静态攻击样本训不出抗注入能力，攻击得跟着一起进化
articles.author: Sarim Hashmi, Mukul Ranjan 等
articles.body: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent.
articles.bodyZh: 网页智能体（Web agents）是这么干活的：它们会读第三方写好的页面，再照着页面去操作，从而帮用户把请求完成。可问题也在这儿——只要有人在页面里埋一条指令，就可能把智能体带偏，让它不按用户原本的目标走。智能体又不能干脆把页面当不存在，因为完成任务需要的值（values）和控件（controls）也都在页面上。现在这些防御手段，是训练前先把一批注入攻击（injections）定死，然后拿它们去微调智能体；可攻击者只要针对训练后的模型变一变，就能绕过去。对抗训练（adversarial training）倒是能让攻击者跟着变，但任务本身还是固定的，所以一个任务一旦被智能体学会，就不再能教它什么了。我们提出了 AdvSim2Real，它让任务课程（task curriculum）、注入攻击对手（injection adversary）和智能体，在一个冻结的网页世界模型（frozen web world model）里一起协同进化。课程会奖励那些智能体大约有一半概率能解决的任务；而对手只有在搞出成功翻转（success flip）时才有奖励——所谓成功翻转，就是一次注入攻击把原本判定成功的结果变成了失败。在模拟器（simulator）里这样训练，会让一个 4B 智能体（4B agent）既更能干、也更抗攻击：不管有没有攻击，它的完成率（completion）都会上升；面对一个它从没训练过的前沿模型对手（frontier-model adversary），它也能顶住；而且能力的提升还能迁移到真实浏览器（real browser）里。在 150 个网络任务（web tasks）上，面对这个没见过的对手，AdvSim2Real 把完成率相对基础智能体（base agent）提高了 33.6%。

articles.title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
articles.zh: VeriFine：以可扩展验证驱动具身推理的自我改进
articles.summary: 如果你在做具身推理的自提升，这篇告诉你瓶颈不在生成而在验证，验证能规模化才真正有用
articles.author: Zewei Zhou, Rachel Luo 等
articles.body: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.
articles.bodyZh: 能自我改进的策略（self-improving policies）会不断暴露出新的失败模式（failure patterns），这就让评审器（judge）必须能验证的东西也跟着变。可问题是，现在这些固定不变的评审器，既卡住了优化反馈（optimization feedback），也限制了发现有价值的训练样本（training examples），于是进一步自我改进就被拖住了。放到具身推理（embodied reasoning）里，这个麻烦更大，因为要想评估靠谱，就得把空间落地（spatial grounding）、因果推理（causal reasoning）和安全感知决策（safety-aware decision-making）都考虑进去。我们提出 VeriFine，一套智能体运行框架（agent harness framework），它靠策略（policy）、训练课程（training curriculum）和评审器（judge）三者共同进化（co-evolution），把验证（verification）规模做大。它的策略改进循环（Policy Improvement Loop）会用一个评分标准评审器（rubric judge）来诊断反复出现的失败，搭出一套自适应课程（adaptive curriculum），再优化策略。等进展停滞、验证变成瓶颈时，评审器改进循环（Judge Improvement Loop）就会挑那些有信息量的失败案例（informative failure cases），有选择地找人给指导，并通过协同校准（coactive calibration）来打磨评审器——也就是让人和智能体一起解决分歧，慢慢对齐到物理推理的客观评分标准（objective rubric of physical reasoning）。改好后的评审器，再去指导下一阶段的数据筛选（data selection）和策略优化。我们在驾驶和机器人导航任务上做了实验，结果不管是在强化学习（reinforcement）还是监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）里，策略和评审器的能力都能持续自我提升。这些结果说明，随着策略失败模式不断演化，把验证规模做大，就能支撑持续的自我改进。

articles.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
articles.summary: 如果你在做世界模型却只有画面没声音，这篇把音频生成加进来，补上多模态里常被忽略的一环
articles.author: Pengjun Fang, Jingyi Fa 等
articles.body: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41. For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
articles.bodyZh: 最近，世界模型（world models）的进展，让视觉合成（visual synthesis）越来越逼真。可这些生成出来的环境，基本还是静悄悄的。要想给世界模型加上声音，有三个核心难题：一是得实时生成（real-time generation），才能跟交互式视频流（interactive video streams）保持同步；二是得能交互控制（interactive control），在视频播放到一半时也能响应声音指令；三是得有空间对齐的立体声（spatially aligned stereo），能反映出场景的几何结构和镜头运动。为了解决这些需求，我们推出了 WorldSonus，这是一个交互式视频转音频框架（interactive video-to-audio framework），专门为世界模型里的实时空间声音合成（real-time spatial sound synthesis）而设计。在实时生成方面，WorldSonus 采用了一种流式因果自回归扩散架构（streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture），能以 0.41 的低实时因子（RTF, real-time factor）合成音频块。在交互控制方面，我们加入了一条以音频为中心的描述生成流程（audio-centric captioning pipeline），并配合按音频块索引的提示调度（chunk-indexed prompt scheduling），这样就能在生成过程中动态操控声音事件。在空间对齐方面，我们利用了从多种立体声（stereo）和 Ambisonic 数据（ambisonic data）中整理出来的高质量立体声监督（stereo supervision）。大量实验表明，虽然 WorldSonus 是为世界模型量身打造的，但它能有效泛化到开放域视频转音频基准（open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks），在声学质量（acoustic quality）和空间对齐（spatial alignment）上，都能追平甚至超过最先进的双向模型（state-of-the-art bidirectional models）。项目页面：https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
